description_for_human: Translate PDF documents while preserving original layout. Supports 10 languages with OCR-powered AI translation.
description_for_model: Translate PDF documents from one language to another using OCR-powered AI translation. The platform supports 10 languages (English, Chinese, Spanish, French, Italian, Greek, Japanese, Korean, German, Russian) and handles scanned/image-based PDFs automatically. Use this when a user needs to translate a PDF document.
